% Lego tower: \legotower{x-offset}{height}{colour}
% Each brick is 0.65 wide x 0.55 tall, with two studs
\newcommand{\legotower}[3]{%
  \foreach \i in {1,...,#2}{%
    \draw[fill=#3!55, draw=#3!80!black, line width=0.35pt]
      (#1, {(\i-1)*0.55}) rectangle (#1+0.65, {\i*0.55});
    \draw[fill=#3!80, draw=#3!80!black, line width=0.2pt]
      (#1+0.15,{(\i-1)*0.55+0.38}) circle (0.08);
    \draw[fill=#3!80, draw=#3!80!black, line width=0.2pt]
      (#1+0.44,{(\i-1)*0.55+0.38}) circle (0.08);
  }%
}

% STARTER 2 — Mean and Median
%------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}{Starter}
\vspace{-0.8em}
\begin{ealglossed}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\itemsep2pt
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item $3 + 7 + 10 = \ashowq{20}$
  \item $48 \div 6 = \ashowq{8}$
  \item $\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{4} = \ashowq{\frac{3}{4}}$
  \item $28 \div 4 = \ashowq{7}$
  \end{multicols}
  \item Which \ealgloss{average}{اوسط} requires you to order the \ealgloss{data}{ڈیٹا} first? \ashow{\ealgloss{Median}{میڈین}}
  \item Find the \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} of: $7,\ 2,\ 9,\ 4,\ 5$ \ashow{$=5$}
  \item Find the \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} of: $3,\ 8,\ 1,\ 6,\ 4,\ 10$ \ashow{$=5$}
  \item Find the \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط} and \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} of: $2,\ 5,\ 3,\ 8,\ 7$.  
        Which is larger? \ashow{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} $=5$, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} $=5$ (equal).}
  \item Find the \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط} and \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} of: $-5,\ 1,\ -2,\ 4,\ 7$ \ashow{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} $=1$, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} $=1$.}
  \item The \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط} of $a,\ a+3,\ a+6$ is $6$.
        \begin{itemize}\footnotesize
        \item What is the \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} in terms of $a$? \ashow{$a+3$}
          \item What is the total of the \ealgloss{data}{ڈیٹا} (use the \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط}) \ashow{$18$}
          \item Find $a$ \ashow{$a=3$}
        \end{itemize}
\end{enumerate}
\end{ealglossed}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Starter -- Solutions}
\vspace{-0.8em}
\begin{ealglossed}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\itemsep2pt
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item $3 + 7 + 10 = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$20$}
  \item $48 \div 6 = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$8$}
  \item $\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{4} = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$\frac{3}{4}$}
  \item $28 \div 4 = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$7$}
\end{multicols}
  \item Which \ealgloss{average}{اوسط} requires ordering first?  
        \textcolor{red}{\ealgloss{Median}{میڈین}}
  \item \ealgloss{Median}{میڈین} of $7,\ 2,\ 9,\ 4,\ 5$  
        \textcolor{red}{$=5$}
  \item \ealgloss{Median}{میڈین} of $3,\ 8,\ 1,\ 6,\ 4,\ 10$  
        \textcolor{red}{$=5$}
  \item \ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} and \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} of $2,\ 5,\ 3,\ 8,\ 7$  
        \textcolor{red}{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} $=5,\ \text{median }=5$}
  \item \ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} and \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} of $-5,\ 1,\ -2,\ 4,\ 7$  
        \textcolor{red}{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} $=1,\ \text{median }=1$}
  \item \ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} of $a,\ a+3,\ a+6$ is $6$
        \begin{itemize}\footnotesize
          \item \ealgloss{Median}{میڈین} \textcolor{red}{$=a+3$}
          \item Total \textcolor{red}{$=18$}
          \item $a=$ \textcolor{red}{$3$}

% STARTER 3 — Mean, Median, Mode
%------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}{Starter}
\vspace{-0.8em}
\begin{ealglossed}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\itemsep2pt
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item $4 + 11 = \ashowq{15}$
  \item $40 \div 8 = \ashowq{5}$
  \item $\frac{3}{4} - \frac{1}{4} = \ashowq{\frac{1}{2}}$
  \item $72 \div 9 = \ashowq{8}$
  \end{multicols}
  \item A shoe shop owner says,  
        ``The most popular size last week was size 6.''  
    Which \ealgloss{average}{اوسط} is she using? \ashow{\ealgloss{Mode}{موڈ}}
  \item Find the \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} of: $3,\ 7,\ 3,\ 9,\ 5,\ 3,\ 7$ \ashow{$3$}
  \item Find the \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} of: $2,\ 5,\ 8,\ 5,\ 3,\ 8,\ 1$ \ashow{$5$ and $8$}
  \item Find the \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط} and \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} of: $4,\ 7,\ 2,\ 9,\ 3$ \ashow{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} $=5$, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} $=4$.}
  \item Find the \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط}, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} and \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} of: $5,\ 3,\ 7,\ 3,\ 5,\ 5,\ 9$ \ashow{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} $=\frac{37}{7}$, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} $=5$, \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} $=5$.}
  \item The \ealgloss{data}{ڈیٹا} \ealgloss{set}{مجموعہ} is $\{4,\ 7,\ 4,\ x,\ 7,\ 3\}$  
        The \textbf{only} \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} is $4$.  
        Find $x$ and explain your reasoning. \ashow{$x=4$; then $4$ occurs three times.}
\end{enumerate}
\end{ealglossed}
\end{frame}


\begin{frame}{Starter -- Solutions}
\vspace{-0.8em}
\begin{ealglossed}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\itemsep2pt
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item $4 + 11 = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$15$}
  \item $40 \div 8 = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$5$}
  \item $\frac{3}{4} - \frac{1}{4} = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$\frac{1}{2}$}
  \item $72 \div 9 = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$8$}
\end{multicols}
  \item Which \ealgloss{average}{اوسط} is used?  
        \textcolor{red}{\ealgloss{Mode}{موڈ}}
  \item \ealgloss{Mode}{موڈ} of $3,\ 7,\ 3,\ 9,\ 5,\ 3,\ 7$  
        \textcolor{red}{$3$}
  \item \ealgloss{Mode}{موڈ} of $2,\ 5,\ 8,\ 5,\ 3,\ 8,\ 1$  
        \textcolor{red}{$5\ \text{and}\ 8$}
  \item \ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} and \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} of $4,\ 7,\ 2,\ 9,\ 3$  
        \textcolor{red}{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} $=5,\ \text{median }=4$}
  \item \ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط}, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} and \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} of $5,\ 3,\ 7,\ 3,\ 5,\ 5,\ 9$  
        \textcolor{red}{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} $=\frac{37}{7}$, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} $=5$, \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} $=5$}
  \item Only \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} is $4$  
        \textcolor{red}{$x=4$}
\end{enumerate}
\end{ealglossed}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Starter}
\vspace{-0.8em}
\begin{ealglossed}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\itemsep2pt
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item $3+4 = \ashowq{7}$
  \item $4 \times 8 = \ashowq{32}$
  \item $-3 + 8 + (-5) = \ashowq{0}$
  \item $\frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{6} = \ashowq{\frac{5}{6}}$
  \item $-12 \div 4 = \ashowq{-3}$
  \item $\frac{3}{4} \times 8 = \ashowq{6}$
  \end{multicols}
  \item A class votes for their favourite colour.  
        Can you find the \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط}?  
        Which \ealgloss{average}{اوسط} should you use instead, and why?  
        \ashow{No; use the \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ}, because the \ealgloss{data}{ڈیٹا} are categories.}
  \item Find the \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط}, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} and \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} of:  
        $-3,\ 1,\ -3,\ 4,\ -1,\ 2,\ -3$ \ashow{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} $=-\frac{3}{7}$, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} $=-1$, \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} $=-3$.}
  \item Find the \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} of:  
        $\frac{1}{4},\ \frac{3}{4},\ \frac{1}{2},\ \frac{1}{8},\ \frac{5}{8}$ \ashow{$\frac{1}{2}$}
  \item The ages in a youth club are:  
        $11,\ 12,\ 12,\ 13,\ 13,\ 13,\ 14,\ 42$
        Which \ealgloss{average}{اوسط} would you not use for this example, and why? \ashow{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط}, because $42$ is an \ealgloss{outlier}{آؤٹ لیر}.}
  \item The \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط} of $\{x,\ 3,\ x,\ 7,\ 5\}$ is $6$.  
        Find $x$ and state the \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ}. \ashow{$x=6$, \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} $=6$}
  \item Five numbers have \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط} $8$, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} $7$ and \ealgloss{unique}{منفرد} \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} of $5$.  
        Two numbers are $5$ and $5$.  
        Find a possible \ealgloss{set}{مجموعہ}. \ashow{$\{5,5,6,7,17\}$}

\end{ealglossed}

\begin{frame}{Starter -- Solutions}
\vspace{-0.8em}
\begin{ealglossed}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\itemsep2pt

  \item $3+4 = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$7$}
  \item $4 \times 8 = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$32$}
  \item $-3 + 8 + (-5) = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$0$}
  \item $\frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{6} = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$\frac{5}{6}$}
  \item $-12 \div 4 = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$-3$}
  \item $\frac{3}{4} \times 8 = \mathord{?}$ \textcolor{red}{$6$}
\end{multicols}
  \item Can you find the \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط}?

  \item \ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط}, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} and \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ}

  \item Which \ealgloss{average}{اوسط} not to use and why?

  \item $x=?$ and \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ}  
        \textcolor{red}{$x=6$, \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} $=6$}

% STARTER 5 — Challenge
%------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}{Starter}
\vspace{-0.8em}
\begin{ealglossed}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\itemsep2pt
\begin{multicols}{2}
\item $3+8 = \ashowq{11}$
\item $120 \div 10 = \ashowq{12}$
  \item $-6 + (-2) + 5 = \ashowq{-3}$
  \item Order from smallest to largest:  
        $\frac{1}{3},\ \frac{5}{6},\ \frac{1}{2},\ \frac{2}{3}$ \ashow{$\frac{1}{3},\ \frac{1}{2},\ \frac{2}{3},\ \frac{5}{6}$}
  \item $3\frac{1}{2} + 2\frac{3}{4} = \ashowq{6\frac{1}{4}}$
  \item $-20 \div 4 = \ashowq{-5}$
  \end{multicols}

  \item Find the \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط}, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} and \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} of:  
        $-6,\ -2,\ 4,\ -3,\ 7,\ 0,\ -2$ \ashow{\ealgloss{Mean}{اوسط} $=-\frac{2}{7}$, \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} $=-2$, \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} $=-2$.}

  \item True or False?  
        ``Adding 10 to every \ealgloss{value}{قدر} increases the \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط} by 10 but leaves the \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} unchanged.''  
        \ashow{True}

  \item The seven \ealgloss{values}{قدر}  
        $n-9,\ n-6,\ n-3,\ n,\ n+3,\ n+6,\ n+9$  
        have a \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط} of $4$.  
        State the \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} \textbf{without calculation}. \ashow{\ealgloss{Median}{میڈین} $=4$}
  \item A \ealgloss{set}{مجموعہ} of five \ealgloss{positive}{مثبت} \ealgloss{integers}{صحيح عدد} has  
        \ealgloss{mean}{اوسط} = \ealgloss{median}{میڈین} = \ealgloss{mode}{موڈ} = $6$.
        \begin{itemize}\footnotesize
          \item What is the smallest possible \ealgloss{range}{رینج}? \ashow{$1$}
          \item What is the largest possible \ealgloss{range}{رینج}? \ashow{$12$}
        \end{itemize}
\end{enumerate}
\end{ealglossed}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Starter -- Solutions}
\vspace{-0.8em}
\begin{ealglossed}
\footnotesize
